title: Coconut lemongrass salmon with aubergine rice
blurb: Tender salmon fillets simmered in fragrant coconut milk with lemongrass, served over rice studded with roasted aubergine and fresh parsley.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C and cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the aubergine into small cubes, toss with half the olive oil, spread on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes until golden and soft.
Bash the lemongrass stalks with the back of a knife to bruise them and release their flavour.
Heat the remaining oil in a wide pan, add the lemongrass and cook for one minute, then pour in the coconut milk and fish sauce and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the salmon fillets to the coconut milk, cover the pan and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes until the fish is just cooked through.
Roughly chop the parsley and stir most of it through the cooked rice along with the roasted aubergine.
Divide the rice between two bowls, place a salmon fillet on top of each and spoon over the coconut sauce, discarding the lemongrass stalks.
Scatter over the remaining parsley and serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
